name: Laste
source:
The green-haired green-eyed Demoness. Calls Lune her older sister. Has a cautious disposition and doesn't display her emotions outwardly often and seldom speaks, but that's not to say she's completely silent. Despite her docile appearance, she's surprisingly emotional. She seethes inwardly when her innate nature to possess and monopolise is thwarted when she cannot obtain what she wants.

She has the ability to "Sever" anything in her line of sight.
